Customer segment: D2C founders running their own store, 100–2,000 orders a month, no finance team
Channel: Warm introductions from mentors and faculty; founder community groups
Offer: 30-minute interview about month-end profit, returns and refunds; no product pitch
Activity: Interview owners about profit leakage: 10 interviews with one fixed script (how profit is computed, how refunds and recovered stock are treated, last month's surprise)
Trial assumption: No trial this week; 6 of 10 agree to share one month of orders for week 2
Cost per acquired customer formula: Not applicable in week 1; cost per interview = 1,000 / interviews completed
Success threshold: At least 6 of 10 cannot state last month's contribution after refunds and recovered stock
Stop rule: Fewer than 4 of 10 describe a profit-leak problem they want solved: stop and change the segment before week 2

Customer segment: Interviewed founders who described leakage and agreed to share data
Channel: Follow-up call and email after the week 1 interview
Offer: Free sample order audit of one month of orders, with the headline gate on
Activity: Run a sample order audit for 5 founders: map their export to the C21 schema, run Leak Desk, walk through the ledger, leaks and one recommendation in 30 minutes
Success threshold: In at least 3 of 5 audits the founder confirms a negative-contribution cause they did not track
Stop rule: Fewer than 3 founders share order data: stop outreach; data access is the blocker, so fix the import first

Offer: Paid pilot of the monthly contribution report at ₹1,500 a month (hypothesis), cancel any time
Activity: Price test: ask each audited founder for a paid pilot; record the price accepted or refused and the product change asked for
Success threshold: At least 2 paid pilots at ₹999 a month or more
Stop rule: None of 5 accepts at ₹999 or more: stop the subscription test and test a one-off audit fee instead

Customer segment: Paying pilot founders and the founders they refer
Channel: Delivery of the first monthly report; referral ask
Offer: First monthly report with one saved decision and its 30-day test
Activity: Deliver the report; shadow the founder's own month-end figures (or a finance-approved contribution report) and record every gap; ask each pilot for one referral
Response assumption: 50% of referred founders agree to an audit
Success threshold: Each pilot's report reconciles to the founder's month-end figures or every gap is explained, and at least 1 pilot renews for month 2
Stop rule: No pilot renews for month 2: stop and return to interviews with the gap list
